name: The 3AM Nose
speech: If it's always the lower nostril, the side you're lying on, that's not pollen.
Pollen doesn't care which side you're sleep on. If it switches sides when you roll over,
that's not just your sinuses. That's the trigger that follows your face around the pillow.
And if it clears within minutes of standing up, and it's gone a week you sleep somewhere else,
then nobody's telling you this. The problem never leaves your bed. It's the most common
thing living in a mattress — just mites. A colony of 100,000 to 10 million of them deep
in the fibers, feeding on the skin you shed every night — right there, inches from your face,
for eight hours a night. And the worst part? Your bedroom can look spotless, because none of this is
in the room. It's inside the mattress, where no wash, spray, or vacuum ever reaches. But here's
what actually fixes this — capture cards. Most mite products try to kill them. This one pulls them
out. A plant-derived pheromone lure draws the mites up out of the deep fibers. The adhesive
locks them on the card, so what it catches comes out of your bed instead of back into it. And your
phone light shows you the catch, so you never have to wonder if it's working.
Slide one under the mattress, one near the pillow, and let them work. The colony comes out of the
mattress. The card shows you how much. And one card keeps going for about three months. Over 30,000
homes are already sleeping cleaner. 90-day money-back guarantee. Link below.
